title: Read herding.transport and give both transport probes a tmux arm
action: Per D1, add to herding.rs: `pub(crate) enum TransportKind { Herdr, Tmux }` with `fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str` ("herdr"/"tmux"), a pure `pub(crate) fn transport_kind(cfg: &Value) -> Result<TransportKind, String>` (key `herding.transport`: absent → Herdr, "herdr" → Herdr, "tmux" → Tmux, anything else → Err naming exactly the two legal values), and `pub(crate) fn transport_kind_at(main_root: &Path) -> Result<TransportKind, String>` that reads `<main_root>/.bee/config.json` (missing or unparseable file → Ok(Herdr), the same fail-open posture `read_command_template_tokens` at `herding.rs:674` takes) and calls `transport_kind`. Probes: KEEP the two existing functions and their signatures untouched so every current test at `herding.rs:897,907,915,923` and `verbs/drivers/tests.rs:1229-1289` stays byte-for-byte unchanged. Add beside each a kind-taking sibling: `transport_state_for(kind: TransportKind, lookup: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<String>) -> Map<String, Value>` in herding.rs (anchor `pub(crate) fn transport_state_with` at 577 — make the old function delegate to the new one with `TransportKind::Herdr`), and `herding_transport_probe_for(kind: TransportKind, env: &dyn Fn(&str) -> Option<String>) -> (bool, String, Option<String>)` in prepare.rs (anchor `pub(crate) fn herding_transport_probe(` at 553 — same delegation). The Tmux arm: ready iff `TMUX` is non-empty AND `TMUX_PANE` is non-empty; reasons, modelled on the herdr arm of the SAME file (the two files already word theirs differently — mirror each file's own style, not the other file's): ready → `TMUX and TMUX_PANE=<pane> are set`; TMUX set but TMUX_PANE empty/missing → `TMUX is set but TMUX_PANE is empty or not set`; TMUX missing → `TMUX is not set — this session is not inside a tmux pane`; the third tuple slot carries the pane id when present. In herding.rs's map add one key `kind` (the `as_str` value) in BOTH arms — this is an additive key, so `bee herding status --json` gains `transport.kind`; the existing keys keep their values. Wire the two production call sites to the new siblings with the kind from `transport_kind_at`: `transport_state()` at `herding.rs:611` (it has `explicit`/main-root resolution in scope from `status`; resolve the root the way the surrounding function does), and the `herding_transport_probe(&|k| std::env::var(k).ok())` call at `prepare.rs:929` (prepare already holds the main root / cfg it used to build the payload — pass that). On `transport_kind_at` Err, `bee herding status` reports `ready:false` with the Err text as the reason and `bee dispatch prepare` sets `transport_ready:false` with the same reason — never a panic. Tests ride the cell, named with the prefix `transport_` so the verify filter reaches them: both tmux reasons and the ready case, the unknown-value Err text, the absent-key default, and the `kind` key on each arm.

truths: With herding.transport absent, the herdr arm's existing keys and reason strings are unchanged; transport.kind == "herdr"
With herding.transport=tmux, TMUX set and TMUX_PANE=%3, bee herding status --json reports transport.ready true and names %3
With herding.transport=nope, status and dispatch prepare report not ready with a reason naming herdr and tmux
